GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled in 4th 3 Lengths . Straightened Up 1 length off, Battled On Well but found the winner too strong late (gap back to 3rd) # ok but no match

Jumped OK. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace until improving slowly Four Wide from 500m. Pushed along & laid out 8W on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & laid in but held ground in straight. # Wide/held ground.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover throughout. RR intention was to attempt to race outside the leader, however from the wide barrier and with runners to her inside showing speed, she was unable to cross and raced wide without cover which was detrimental to the gelding’s performance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Settled Down Two Wide 5th 3 Lengths @ 1200m. came out 3 Wide into Straight =2nd. loomed up. peaked 150m? Held Ground from there. winner led # ok/peaked 150m

jumped awkwardly & bumped @ start . Not pushed early & raced well back on inside (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken @ 500m. Chasing Six Wide & bumped (6L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & no improvement in straight. # Never a chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted out. Near the 1100m contacted the rail and became unbalanced. Held up from the 350m until shifting out over heels to obtain clear running near the 250m. Rider reported near the 1100m when the pace slackened he improved up inside the heels of I Could Do Better which shifted out marginally when being restrained before being checked. He added the gelding had some difficulty obtaining clear running rounding the home turn and failed to run on when clear and in his opinion, may not have appreciated the 69kg weight impost. A post race Vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th Wide No Cover 3-4l slotted in mid race but very Hard Ridden Lost Ground from the 600 weakened right out , felt amiss , nothing detected # Wide early/btn.600
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover from the 1000m. Rider reported that he felt there may have been something amiss with the gelding. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.
